title: Suggested: Fix Blender-Procedural-Human quality gate Python environment
description: BLEN-15 attempt 1 failed because the pytest quality gate ran with Daud's venv python (/Users/acw28/Code/Daud/.venv/bin/python) which doesn't have pytest. The Blender-Procedural-Human quality gate command 'python -m pytest' needs to either: (a) use the repo's own venv, (b) prefix with 'uv run' to resolve from the repo's pyproject, or (c) use an absolute path to the correct interpreter. This caused a full 26-minute agent run to be wasted.
definition-of-done: Blender-Procedural-Human quality gates use the correct Python environment and pytest is found
testing-plan: Run daud-worker on a BLEN ticket and verify pytest gate passes
